name: banproof-mcp
description: Audit TikTok Shop and Amazon affiliate video scripts for policy violations. Flags medical claims, urgency/scarcity, fake social proof, income claims, missing FTC disclosures, price claims, and AIGC disclosure gaps. Returns safe rewrites, TikTok violation point totals, and ready-to-submit appeal text.

tools.name: audit_script
tools.description: Audit a video script for policy violations. Detects medical claims, guarantees, false certifications, urgency/scarcity, fake social proof, income claims, missing FTC disclosures, price claims, and AIGC disclosure gaps. Optionally cross-checks script claims against a product page URL. Returns flagged phrases with safe rewrites, overall risk level, and TikTok violation point totals.

tools.name: generate_appeal
tools.description: Generate a ready-to-submit appeal response for a TikTok, Amazon, or YouTube policy violation notice. Stays within TikTok's 800-character appeal limit. Returns formatted appeal text with character count.
